bottleneck: RiverSwim controls did not qualify in the completed reference-life scorecard. Slower exploration decay lost in PR #3214; differential SARSA bias and exploration calibration is already covered by #3184.
hypothesis: At the existing fixed exploration schedule and step size, changing discounted SARSA lamda from 0.0 to 0.8 will improve lifetime reward by propagating the delayed upstream reward through recently eligible state/action features. The same traces can also propagate the small left reward; benefit is a prediction, not assumed.
mechanism_basis: The existing DiscountedSARSAReferenceAdapter forwards config.lamda to SARSAAgent. core/sarsa.py decays and credits inactive action-head traces with the same TD error when lamda > 0. With gamma approximately 0.9 and lamda approximately 0.8, their per-step decay coefficient is approximately 0.72. The arm with lamda=0 is the mechanism-off control.
seed_role: Fresh development-only seeds; no frozen, consumed scorecard or prior diagnostic seed is reused. Not held-out scientific evaluation.
decision: Support only if every paired primary delta is positive and their mean exceeds 0.01. Otherwise classify as negative if all are nonpositive or the mean is nonpositive; mixed nonqualifying gains are inconclusive. No alternate metric can rescue a failed primary rule.
secondary_metrics: first upstream reward event, with null meaning censored at horizon
controls: All default RiverSwimConfig and DiscountedSARSAReferenceConfig values except lamda remain equal, including epsilon 0.5 to 0.02 over 2500 steps, gamma 0.9, step_size 0.05 and the empty hidden network. Full existing ReferenceLifeRunner handles every event. No accelerated substitute, reward shaping, forced action or restart.
resource_policy: At most two CPU shards concurrently; OMP, OpenBLAS and MKL threads set to 1; JAX preallocation disabled. Equal event/update budgets; record endpoint numeric state bytes and leaves for both arms. One-event preflight at seed100499 in each arm observed equal 220-byte numeric state. Preflight is excluded from comparison. Total process/peak native memory and calibrated latency are not claimed; added trace arithmetic is not assumed free.
integrity_policy: Plan and run script committed and draft PR opened before comparison starts. Each fresh process binds plan/script/source/runtime hashes, source commit and full reward/action/position traces; outputs refuse overwrite. Stop and retain incomplete attempts on execution or identity failure. No seed substitution, continuation or tuning from observed outcomes.
scope_limit: Separate permanently nonpromoting development diagnostic. Does not qualify the frozen scorecard, populate reference-dev, establish transfer/retention or claim general SARSA(lambda) superiority. Three paired seeds cannot establish robust statistical confidence. A positive screen would require separately planned confirmation and regression/transfer checks before any integrated selection.
